tracesTo: SOW: Edge Cases - NFL stat corrections
UserFlow: Weekly Commissioner Desk → Optional Content Creation & Publishing to Feed

stories.title: Configure Sync Schedule by Season Phase
stories.goal: adjust data synchronization frequency based on NFL season state and league activity
stories.benefit: FSHQ optimizes API usage and ensures timely updates during active weeks while reducing overhead during off-season
acceptanceCriteria: System syncs every 5 minutes during active game days (Thursday through Monday during NFL season)
System syncs hourly on Tuesday and Wednesday during regular season
System syncs daily during off-season or when no active matchups exist
System increases sync frequency to every 2 minutes during playoff weeks
System adjusts schedule automatically when NFL season state changes

stories.title: Execute Scheduled League Data Sync Job
stories.goal: poll external fantasy platform APIs on schedule and trigger synchronization workflows
stories.benefit: FSHQ maintains current league data without manual intervention
acceptanceCriteria: System executes sync job based on configured schedule for each connected league
System queues sync requests to prevent concurrent syncs for same league
System logs sync job start time, duration, and completion status
System handles sync job failures with exponential backoff retry logic
System prevents overlapping syncs by checking lock status before starting new job

stories.title: Perform Differential Sync for League Updates
stories.goal: identify and synchronize only changed data since last successful sync
stories.benefit: FSHQ reduces API calls and database writes by avoiding redundant data processing
acceptanceCriteria: System tracks last sync timestamp for each league and data type
System compares fetched data against stored data using version timestamps or checksums
System updates only entities that have changed since last sync
System processes new transactions, matchup scores, and roster changes incrementally
System marks sync as successful only after all differential updates complete

stories.title: Detect NFL Stat Corrections Post-Matchup
stories.goal: identify when matchup scores change due to NFL stat corrections after initial results posted
stories.benefit: FSHQ can trigger re-grading of predictions and pick'ems when official scores change
acceptanceCriteria: System compares current matchup scores against previously stored scores for completed weeks
System detects score changes greater than 0.1 points as potential stat corrections
System logs stat correction events with old score, new score, and detection timestamp
System continues monitoring completed matchups for 72 hours after week conclusion
System flags affected matchups for re-grading and notification generation

stories.title: Trigger Automated Re-Grading on Stat Correction
stories.goal: automatically recalculate pick'ems results and commissioner predictions when scores change
stories.benefit: FSHQ maintains accurate standings and predictions without manual intervention
acceptanceCriteria: System identifies all pick'ems entries and predictions affected by stat correction
System recalculates winners and losers based on corrected scores
System updates pick'ems leaderboards and user statistics with new results
System marks affected predictions as re-graded with correction timestamp
System generates notification moments for stat corrections that change outcomes

stories.title: Track and Display Sync Status per League
stories.goal: view current synchronization status and health for each connected league
stories.benefit: Admins can monitor data freshness and troubleshoot sync issues quickly
acceptanceCriteria: System displays last successful sync timestamp for each league
System shows sync status (active, idle, error, paused) with visual indicators
System displays time until next scheduled sync
System logs and displays recent sync errors with error messages
System provides manual trigger option for immediate sync if needed

stories.title: Handle Sync Failures with Retry Logic
stories.goal: recover from temporary sync failures without losing data or requiring manual intervention
stories.benefit: FSHQ maintains reliability even when external APIs are temporarily unavailable
acceptanceCriteria: System implements exponential backoff retry for failed sync attempts (1min, 2min, 5min, 15min)
System logs detailed error information for each failed sync attempt
System sends alert to admins if sync fails after 4 consecutive retry attempts
System automatically resumes normal sync schedule after successful retry
System preserves partial sync progress to avoid re-fetching successfully synced data

stories.title: Prioritize Critical Data in Sync Jobs
stories.goal: ensure high-priority data types sync first during scheduled jobs
stories.benefit: FSHQ displays critical updates like match scores before lower-priority historical data
acceptanceCriteria: System syncs current week matchup scores with highest priority
System syncs recent transactions (last 7 days) with high priority
System syncs roster changes with medium priority
System syncs historical data and past seasons with low priority
System completes high-priority syncs before starting low-priority data fetches
